director.text: Namaste Riya! Main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj cricket pitch jaisi number line par fractions dekhenge—tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
haan

Cricket pitch ko ek number line socho: ek stump 0 par hai aur doosra stump 1 par. Batsman run ke liye bhaaga aur theek beech mein ruk gaya. Woh pitch ke ek pakke spot par khada hai, aur us spot ka bhi ek number hota hai. Badhiya, Riya.
haan samajh gayi
Screen par 0 se 1 ki line hai, aur theek beech mein ek mark. Yeh mark 0 se 1 ko 2 barabar gaps mein baant raha hai, aur is mark ka naam 1/2 hai. Yahan tak theek hai?
mujhe nahi pata
0 se 1 ki line ko 2 barabar gaps mein baanto. Beech wala mark 1/2 hai, aur woh 0 aur 1 ke beech hi hai. Chalo, aage dekhte hain.
Hindi mein bolo
Theek hai, Riya. Ab se main saral Hindi mein, Roman lipi mein samjhaungi. Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/3, 3 ke paas aata hai. 1/3 kahaan hai: isi 0 se 1 wali line par, ya 3 ke paas?
director.card: Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/3, 3 ke paas aata hai. 1/3 kahaan hai: isi 0 se 1 wali line par, ya 3 ke paas?

director.text: pata nahi, aap batao
Socho, 0 se 1 wali line ko teen barabar hisson mein baantna hai. Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/3, 3 ke paas aata hai. 1/3 kahaan hai: isi 0 se 1 wali line par, ya 3 ke paas?
director.card: Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/3, 3 ke paas aata hai. 1/3 kahaan hai: isi 0 se 1 wali line par, ya 3 ke paas?

director.text: pata nahi, aap batao
0 se 1 tak ke beech 1/3 ko rakho, 3 ke paas nahi. Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/3, 3 ke paas aata hai. 1/3 kahaan hai: isi 0 se 1 wali line par, ya 3 ke paas?
director.card: Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/3, 3 ke paas aata hai. 1/3 kahaan hai: isi 0 se 1 wali line par, ya 3 ke paas?

director.text: 0 se 1 wali line par

Bilkul, Riya—tumne sahi jagah chuni: 1/3, 0 aur 1 ke beech wali line par hota hai, kyunki 1/3 ka matlab 0 se 1 ke 3 barabar gaps mein se pehla gap, toh woh isi line par hai. Screen par upar wahi 0 se 1 ki line hai, par ab beech mein 3 marks hain. Marks nahi, gaps dekho: 4 barabar gaps hain, isliye 0 ke baad pehla mark 1/4 hai. Neeche ek doosri line hai, jis par beech mein 7 marks hain. Yeh kadam saaf hai?
haan
Ab neeche wali doosri line dekho. Neeche wali line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks barabar doori par hain. Woh line kitne barabar gaps mein bati hai?
director.card: Neeche wali line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks barabar doori par hain. Woh line kitne barabar gaps mein bati hai?

director.text: drawing karke samjhao
Dekho, yahi 1/4 ab patti par. Neeche wali line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks barabar doori par hain. Woh line kitne barabar gaps mein bati hai?
director.card: Neeche wali line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks barabar doori par hain. Woh line kitne barabar gaps mein bati hai?

director.text: 8 hai na

Haan, sahi hai, kyunki beech ke marks se gaps hamesha ek zyada hote hain, 7 + 1 = 8. Screen par 0 se 1 ki line ab 8 barabar gaps mein bati hai, toh har gap pehle se chhota gap hai. Pehla mark 1/8 hai, bilkul 0 ke paas, aur beech wala mark abhi bhi 1/2 hai. Yeh kadam saaf hai?
samajh nahi aaya
Line ke jitne zyada gaps, har gap utna chhota. Isliye 1/8 wala pehla mark 0 ke bilkul paas hai. Agar yahi line 10 barabar gaps mein bati ho, toh 0 ke zyada paas kaun hoga: 1/5 ya 1/10?
director.card: Agar yahi line 10 barabar gaps mein bati ho, toh 0 ke zyada paas kaun hoga: 1/5 ya 1/10?

director.text: pata nahi
Riya, 0 se 1 tak 10 barabar gaps hain. Agar yahi line 10 barabar gaps mein bati ho, toh 0 ke zyada paas kaun hoga: 1/5 ya 1/10?
director.card: Agar yahi line 10 barabar gaps mein bati ho, toh 0 ke zyada paas kaun hoga: 1/5 ya 1/10?

director.text: 1/10 hai na

Haan, sahi hai, kyunki 10 barabar gaps ka har gap 5 gaps wale gap se chhota hai, toh 1/10, 0 ke zyada paas rukta hai. Diya hai: ghar 0 par, school 1 km par, beech mein 3 khambe, barabar doori par. Dhoondhna hai: pehle khambe ki ghar se doori, km mein. Ab isse aage chalte hain.
haan samajh gayi
Pehla kadam dekho. Line banao aur ghar ko 0 par, school ko 1 par likho: 0 se 1 tak ki line, kyunki 0 se 1 tak ka poora raasta hi humara ek poora hai. Yahan tak theek hai?
pata nahi
Ghar ko 0 par aur school ko 1 par rakho. Ghar se school tak ka poora raasta ek poora hai. Chalo, aage dekhte hain.
theek hai
Ab doosra kadam. Khambe nahi, beech ke gaps gino: 3 khambe, toh 4 barabar hisse, kyunki beech ke marks se gaps hamesha ek zyada hote hain. Ab isse aage chalte hain.
aapko virat pasand hai?

Virat: iski baat is hissa ke baad karenge. Lesson khatam hone se pehle hum cricket wali misaal par lautenge. Raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, aur pehla khamba ghar se theek ek gap door hai. Toh pehla khamba kitne km par hai?
director.card: Raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, aur pehla khamba ghar se theek ek gap door hai. Toh pehla khamba kitne km par hai?

director.text: pehle main try karun?

Aur Virat ki baat: Virat Kohli India ke liye batting karte hain, aur unka cover drive bahut mashhoor hai. Haan Riya, pehle tum hi karo. Raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, aur pehla khamba ghar se theek ek gap door hai. Toh pehla khamba kitne km par hai?
director.card: Raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, aur pehla khamba ghar se theek ek gap door hai. Toh pehla khamba kitne km par hai?

director.text: 1/3 km

1/3 km sahi nahi hai. Screen par 0 se 1 metre tak ka ribbon hai, beech mein 3 chalk ke nishaan hain, aur ribbon 4 barabar hisson mein bata hai. Bhinn hisse ka naam hai, nishaan ka nahi, isliye pehla nishaan 1/4 metre par hai. Yeh kadam saaf hai?
samajh nahi aaya

Toh poora jawab: pehla khamba ghar se 1/4 km door hai, kyunki raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, har gap 1/4 km ka, aur pehla khamba 0 se ek gap par hai. Pehle gaps gino, marks nahi. 2 marks se line jitne barabar gaps mein bati, wahi number neeche aata hai. Screen par 0 se 1 tak ki line hai, aur beech mein 2 marks barabar doori par hain. 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa bhinn hai?
director.card: Screen par 0 se 1 tak ki line hai, aur beech mein 2 marks barabar doori par hain. 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa bhinn hai?

director.text: 1/2 sahi nahi hai. Aur pehle wale sawaal ka jawab 1/4 km tha, kyunki raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, har gap 1/4 km ka, aur pehla khamba 0 se ek gap par hai. Apna bhinn batao. Screen par 0 se 1 tak ki line hai, aur beech mein 2 marks barabar doori par hain. 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa bhinn hai?
director.card: Screen par 0 se 1 tak ki line hai, aur beech mein 2 marks barabar doori par hain. 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa bhinn hai?

director.text: 1/2 sahi nahi hai. Try karo. Screen par 0 se 1 tak ki line hai, aur beech mein 2 marks barabar doori par hain. 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa bhinn hai?
director.card: Screen par 0 se 1 tak ki line hai, aur beech mein 2 marks barabar doori par hain. 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa bhinn hai?

director.text: 1/2 sahi nahi hai. Pichhle sawaal ka jawab 1/3 tha, kyunki beech ke 2 marks line ko 3 barabar gaps mein baantte hain, aur pehla mark ek gap par hai. Ek baar 0 se 1 ko 3 barabar gaps mein baanto, ek baar 10 barabar gaps mein. 0 ke zyada paas kaun hai: 1/3 ya 1/10?
director.card: Ek baar 0 se 1 ko 3 barabar gaps mein baanto, ek baar 10 barabar gaps mein. 0 ke zyada paas kaun hai: 1/3 ya 1/10?

director.text: 1/3 sahi nahi hai. Screen par 0 se 1 ki ek hi line par teen mark hain: 1/2, 1/4 aur 1/8, aur 1/8 bilkul 0 ke paas hai. Neeche ka number jitna bada, hissa utna chhota, aur woh 0 ke utna paas rukta hai. Ab tak samajh aaya?
pata nahi
1/6 wala gap 1/3 wale gap se chhota hota hai. Chhota gap 0 ke zyada paas rukta hai. Screen par 0 se 1 ki line par 1/3 ka mark hai. 1/6 kahaan aayega: 0 aur 1/3 ke beech, ya 1/3 ke baad?
director.card: Screen par 0 se 1 ki line par 1/3 ka mark hai. 1/6 kahaan aayega: 0 aur 1/3 ke beech, ya 1/3 ke baad?

director.text: between 0 and 1/3 hai na

Bilkul, Riya—tumne sahi kaha: 1/6, 0 aur 1/3 ke beech aayega, kyunki 1/6 ka hissa 1/3 ke hisse ka aadha hai, toh 1/6, 1/3 se pehle rukta hai. Aur pehle wale sawaal ka jawab 1/10 tha, kyunki 10 gaps wala hissa 3 gaps wale hisse se chhota hai, toh 1/10, 0 ke zyada paas rukta hai. 0 se 3 tak ki sankhya rekha par 1/2 kin do poore numbers ke beech aata hai?
director.card: 0 se 3 tak ki sankhya rekha par 1/2 kin do poore numbers ke beech aata hai?

director.text: halfway between 0 and 1
Haan, sahi hai, kyunki 1/2 ek poore ka aadha hai, toh woh 0 aur 1 ke beech aata hai. Tumhe yeh kaise pata chala?
pata nahi kaise, bas laga

Theek, Riya. Ab tak humne 0 se sirf ek gap liya, jaise 1/4. Agle hisse mein 0 se 2 ya 3 gap chalenge, aur upar ka number batayega ki kitne gap chalna hai. Screen par 0 se 1 ki line 3 barabar gaps mein bati hai. 0 se 2 hop lage hain, har hop 1/3 ka, aur hum 2/3 wale mark par pahunche. 2/3 ek hi jagah hai, ek hi number. Yeh kadam saaf hai?
mujhe lagta hai haan
Pakka samajhne ke liye ansh hops ginta hai, har kul gaps; ab isi niyam ka naya prayog karo. Ab line ko 4 barabar gaps mein baanto aur 0 se 3 hop lo. Kis bhinn par pahunchoge?
director.card: Ab line ko 4 barabar gaps mein baanto aur 0 se 3 hop lo. Kis bhinn par pahunchoge?

director.text: 4/3 sahi nahi hai. Teen hops gino: pehle, doosre, teesre. Ab line ko 4 barabar gaps mein baanto aur 0 se 3 hop lo. Kis bhinn par pahunchoge?
director.card: Ab line ko 4 barabar gaps mein baanto aur 0 se 3 hop lo. Kis bhinn par pahunchoge?

director.text: 4/3 sahi nahi hai. Ab line ko 4 barabar gaps mein baanto aur 0 se 3 hop lo. Kis bhinn par pahunchoge?
director.card: Ab line ko 4 barabar gaps mein baanto aur 0 se 3 hop lo. Kis bhinn par pahunchoge?

director.text: three quarters

Haan, sahi hai, kyunki har hop 1/4 ka hai aur 0 se 3 hop liye, toh hum 3/4 par hain. Screen par teesra hop dekho: woh theek 1 par utra, aur wahan likha hai 3/3 = 1. 3/3 mein upar aur neeche barabar hain, isliye hop theek 1 par khatam hue. Agar har hop 1/5 ka ho, toh 0 se chalkar theek 1 tak pahunchne mein kitne hop lagenge?
director.card: Agar har hop 1/5 ka ho, toh 0 se chalkar theek 1 tak pahunchne mein kitne hop lagenge?

director.text: bas aaj ke liye itna hi
Theek hai, Riya. Tum keh rahi ho ki aaj yahin rukna hai. Hum jaari rakhein, thoda viram lein, ya aaj ka paath yahin samaapt karein?
